d:
Rep. Greg Stanton, a Democrat from Arizona who serves on the House Foreign Affairs and China Select committees, says Nvidia’s board should testify as Congress investigates Jensen Huang and the company. Stanton, who will take part in Huang’s closed-door interview next week, says the House should also get answers from Huang in a public hearing. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
More on Bloomberg Television and Markets
